# 10  Z  - program.z(qr[0])
# 11  XZ - program.x(qr[0]) program.z(qr[0])
program.x(qr[0])

# Measure the value of the qubits, they should be equally 00 and 11, one of the Bell states.
program.measure(qr, cr);

# Execute the program.
